# SFM PRO Enterprise - Copilot Instructions

## Project

SFM PRO Enterprise is a personal finance management application.

## Technology

- HTML5
- CSS3
- Vanilla JavaScript (ES6)
- Firebase (future)
- LocalStorage (current)

## Coding Rules

- Keep code modular.
- Use meaningful variable names.
- Never duplicate code.
- Use comments only when necessary.
- Keep functions small.
- Follow existing project structure.

## UI Rules

- Responsive design
- Dark theme
- Modern cards
- Mobile-friendly
- Consistent spacing

## Business Rules

- Never change financial calculations without approval.
- Never remove existing functionality.
- Preserve localStorage data.
- Validate all user inputs.

## Development Rules

- Explain the implementation plan first.
- Modify only requested files.
- Do not create unnecessary files.
- Keep HTML, CSS, and JavaScript separate.
- Test before suggesting completion.

## Output Format

1. Plan
2. Files to modify
3. Code
4. Testing steps
